briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-3 escalate frontier model race amid compute shortages

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases as AGI capabilities approach critical thresholds. Global funding surges past $11B this quarter driven by infrastructure bets. Prompt injection remains the dominant production risk across deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with native multi-agent orchestration; xAI releases Grok-3 claiming parity on reasoning benchmarks. DeepSeek-V3 and Meta's Llama-4 follow within days. Google DeepMind previews Gemini 3.0 internal testing.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic workflows.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 2nm AI chip volume production for Nvidia and AMD. Microsoft and Google announce joint $40B hyperscale campus expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent dialect protocols become mandatory for all frontier deployments by 2027?
